raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 was delivered twice: every txn_id in it (333 unique ids, 666 rows) appears once with ingest_ts 2026-01-19 02:00 and again with 05:00, and the silver step has no deduplication, so the duplicates flow into silver and the gold tables. The fix is to keep one row per txn_id (the latest ingest) before applying the POSTED filter; the gold steps then rebuild correctly without changes.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
